digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery on mute paths
propositions: A failed tickets-branch push is undeliverable on three surfaces: async (detached Popen with stderr=DEVNULL), library embedders (NullHandler attached, stderr never installed), and MCP server (writes to server stderr, agent reads only tool result), making warnings from git rejections and lock-timeouts invisible to callers.

The remedy is a durable marker in the git dir recording push failures (reason, detail, remote_ref, unpushed count, timestamp) and exposing it via rebar.push_status() for libraries, push_status field on MCP write-tool outputs, and polling synchronization for the detached-child async path.

The marker is recorded unconditionally at the single _raise_if_strict choke point that all terminal push failures already route through, covering the commit-phase and recovery reasons but excluding the four no-attempt reasons (push-disabled, async-delivery-unobservable, remote-not-found, invalid-destination) to avoid false pending state on local-only stores.

The marker lives in the git dir (not working tree) to preserve the byte-identical git status that held-out tests pin and to survive linked worktrees; no suffix is used to prevent collision with event rglob searches.

The contract constraint 'a failed push never fails the caller' is preserved: push_tickets_branch still returns None, no CLI exit codes change, no exceptions raised on the default path, and unwritable markers do not fail the write.
A successful push clears the marker; the reconciler limb is fixed structurally through disk recording regardless of logger root, pinned by AC3 driving with no handler on rebar root.
